name: Truman
source:
One of the top CORE army commanders. His brain was moved in into a cyborg body to fight for Gamerica and so he has become a CORE.

Former religious cult leader. He proclaimed himself as a God and leaded the religion, at the core of which was teaching about murder and death. He thinks that if destroy the body human soul can be set free, for bodies of humans are dirty.

"My mission as God is to save souls of pure men by releasing them from the flesh of men, shackles of Satan."
